protocol.targets: seed % 6; no hidden truth supplied to diagnosis
protocol.training: none; physical heuristics fixed before first run
protocol.split: new seeds/target/cutoff; existing equation families are NOT held out

definitions.precision_recall: micro cause-set precision/recall, thermal symptom counts unsupported
definitions.accuracy: top cause belongs to injected set; correct abstention for no modeled cause
definitions.abstention_coverage: fraction with no hypothesis, NOT an accuracy
definitions.transport: delay/drop families lack a representable cause; expected to abstain

limitations: Same synthetic equations and fault families used during original development
Seed holdout does not establish unseen-fault or real-world generalization
Weak pump and load bursts cannot be uniquely identified without command/history inputs
High precision may be traded for lower recall/coverage; all false negatives retained
No AMD/Pinecone/MI300X call or hosted diagnostic performance evaluated

grounded_explanations: Fresh sensor disagrees with independent energy observer; bias/freeze candidate, not proof of malicious spoofing
